observations.text: Hot work permit file had no records.
A choked drain had caused oil/water emulsion to leak into the tank top; inspector asked for it to be cleaned up.

style: Goes through documents and records in detail.
Asks crew directly in the master's cabin.
Wants to hear specific words such as 'permit'.
Looks extensively in the engine room bilges.
Accepts recent annual survey tests for blackout and emergency generator.

summary: Inspection in Antwerp by Capt. Anuj Malik (ENOC). He went through documents and records in detail, asked crew directly in the master's cabin, and looked extensively in the engine room bilges. He raised observations on hot work permit records and a choked drain causing oil/water emulsion on the tank top.
